IS : 7726 - 1975 EXPLANATORY NOTE

This standard is based on DIN 103 Blatt 6 (October 1972) Metrisches ISO-Trapezgewinde Grenzmasse fur Muttergewinde Von 105 bis 300 mm Nenndurchmesser (IS0 metric trapezoidal internal screw threads from 105 to 300 mm diameter; Limits of sizes), issued by Deutscher Normenausschuss. This standard is one of a series of Indian standards being prepared on IS0 metric trapezoidal screw threads. The other standards published so far in the series are : IS : 7008 (Part I)-1973 IS0 metric trapezoidal screw threads: screw threads: Part I Basic and design profiles Part II Pitch diameter combinations Part III Basicdimensionsfor system range 8 to design

IS : 7008 (Part II)-1 973 IS0 metric trapezoidal IS : 7008 (Part Ill)-1973 profiles IS : 7008 (Part IV) -1973 IS : 7684-1975 100 mm) IS : 7685-1975 100 mm) IS : 7727-1975 300 mm)

IS0 metric trapezoidal screw threads: IS0 metric trapezoidal IS0 IS0

screw threads : Part IV Tolerancing nut threads bolt threads (diameter

This standard is based on DIN 103 Blatt 6 (October 1972) Metrisches ISO � Trapezgewinde, Grenzmasse fur Muttergewinde von 105 bis 300 mm Nenndurchrnesser (ISO metric trapezoidal screw threads; Limits of sizes for inter'nal screw threads from 105 to 300 mm diameter, issued by Deutscher Normenausschuss (DNA). This standard is one of a series of Indian Standards on ISO metric trapezoidal screw threads.
